works.title: Stable Video Diffusion
works.description: Stable Video Diffusion (2023-11-21) was the first widely used open-weight image-to-video model, turning a still image into 14- or 25-frame clips; it also served as the base for multi-view 3D generators.
works.description_zh: Stable Video Diffusion（2023-11-21）是首个被广泛使用的开源图生视频模型，可把一张静态图变成 14 或 25 帧短片，也被用作多视角三维生成的基础模型。
works.idea_en: Gave researchers a video prior they could fine-tune; many later 3D and 4D generators start from SVD weights.
works.idea_zh: 为研究者提供了可微调的视频先验，后来许多三维、四维生成方法都从 SVD 权重起步。
works.method: Latent video diffusion with temporal layers added to Stable Diffusion 2.1, trained in three stages: image pretraining, curated video pretraining and high-quality fine-tuning.
works.method_zh: 在 Stable Diffusion 2.1 上加入时间层的潜空间视频扩散模型，分三阶段训练：图像预训练、精选视频预训练和高质量微调。

paper.title: Stable Video Diffusion: Scaling Latent Video Diffusion Models to Large Datasets

works.title: CogVideoX
works.description: Zhipu AI's CogVideoX (open-sourced 2024-08-06) was the first strong open text-to-video model from a Chinese lab, generating 6-second 720×480 clips; it powers Zhipu's Qingying product.
works.description_zh: 智谱的 CogVideoX（2024-08-06 开源）是国内实验室首个表现强劲的开源文生视频模型，可生成 6 秒 720×480 视频，也是智谱“清影”产品的底座。
works.idea_en: Showed an open model could run on a single consumer GPU and be fine-tuned by labs for their own scenarios.
works.idea_zh: 证明开源模型能在单张消费级显卡上运行，并能被实验室按自身场景微调。
works.method: Diffusion transformer with a 3D causal VAE and an 'expert transformer' whose expert adaptive LayerNorm fuses text and video tokens.
works.method_zh: 带 3D 因果 VAE 的扩散 Transformer，用带专家自适应 LayerNorm 的“专家 Transformer”融合文本与视频 token。

paper.title: CogVideoX: Text-to-Video Diffusion Models with An Expert Transformer

works.title: Mochi 1
works.description: Genmo's Mochi 1 (2024-10-22) was a 10-billion-parameter open text-to-video model under Apache 2.0, with motion quality and prompt adherence that were strong for its time.
works.description_zh: Genmo 的 Mochi 1（2024-10-22）是 100 亿参数、Apache 2.0 许可的开源文生视频模型，运动质量与提示遵循在当时表现较强。
works.idea_en: Permissive licensing made it a common base for academic fine-tuning and benchmarking.
works.idea_zh: 宽松的许可使其成为学术微调与评测中常用的基础模型。
works.method: Asymmetric Diffusion Transformer (AsymmDiT) with a video VAE that compresses 128x and a single T5-XXL text encoder.
works.method_zh: 非对称扩散 Transformer（AsymmDiT），视频 VAE 压缩 128 倍，只用一个 T5-XXL 文本编码器。

works.title: LTX-Video
works.description: Lightricks' LTX-Video (2024-11-22) was the first open video model fast enough to generate clips faster than they play: about five seconds of 768×512 video in roughly four seconds on an H100. A 13B version followed in May 2025.
works.description_zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-Video（2024-11-22）是首个生成速度快于播放速度的开源视频模型：在 H100 上约 4 秒生成 5 秒 768×512 视频。13B 版本于 2025 年 5 月推出。
works.idea_en: Generation faster than real time is the precondition for any loop in which a scene reacts to a participant.
works.idea_zh: 生成快于实时，是场景能对参与者作出反应的任何闭环的前提。
works.method: DiT with a highly compressed VAE (1:192) whose decoder also performs the final denoising step.
works.method_zh: 采用高压缩比 VAE（1:192）的 DiT，VAE 解码器同时完成最后一步去噪。
works.specs: 2B / 13B · 768×512 · 24 fps · faster than real time on H100

paper.title: LTX-Video: Realtime Video Latent Diffusion

works.title: HunyuanVideo
works.description: Tencent's HunyuanVideo (2024-12-03) was the largest open video model at release, at 13 billion parameters; Tencent reported it outperformed Runway Gen-3 and Luma 1.6 in professional human evaluation.
works.description_zh: 腾讯的 HunyuanVideo（2024-12-03）发布时是参数规模最大的开源视频模型（130 亿）；腾讯称其在专业人工评测中优于 Runway Gen-3 和 Luma 1.6。
works.idea_en: Briefly closed the gap between open and closed video quality and seeded a large ecosystem of LoRAs and control adapters.
works.idea_zh: 一度缩小了开源与闭源视频模型的质量差距，并带动了大量 LoRA 与控制适配器生态。
works.method: Dual-stream-to-single-stream diffusion transformer with a 3D causal VAE and a multimodal LLM as text encoder.
works.method_zh: 从双流到单流的扩散 Transformer，配 3D 因果 VAE，并用多模态大语言模型作为文本编码器。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo: A Systematic Framework For Large Video Generative Models

works.title: Wan 2.1
works.description: Alibaba's Wan 2.1 (open-sourced 2025-02-25 under Apache 2.0) provides 14B and 1.3B text- and image-to-video models; the small one needs about 8 GB of VRAM. It became the base of many research and community models, including VACE, Self Forcing and Krea Realtime.
works.description_zh: 阿里巴巴的通义万相 Wan 2.1（2025-02-25 以 Apache 2.0 开源）提供 140 亿和 13 亿参数的文生/图生视频模型，小模型约需 8 GB 显存。它成为 VACE、Self Forcing、Krea Realtime 等众多研究与社区模型的基础。
works.idea_en: The open base most 2025 real-time and control research was built on, so findings transfer between labs.
works.idea_zh: 2025 年的实时与控制研究大多以它为基础，因此不同实验室的结果可以相互迁移。
works.method: Diffusion transformer trained with flow matching and a new causal 3D VAE (Wan-VAE) that encodes 1080p video of unlimited length.
works.method_zh: 以流匹配训练的扩散 Transformer，配合新的因果 3D VAE（Wan-VAE），可编码任意长度的 1080p 视频。

paper.title: Wan: Open and Advanced Large-Scale Video Generative Models

works.title: Step-Video-T2V
works.description: StepFun's Step-Video-T2V (2025-02-17) is a 30-billion-parameter open text-to-video model that generates up to 204 frames from Chinese or English prompts.
works.description_zh: 阶跃星辰的 Step-Video-T2V（2025-02-17）是 300 亿参数的开源文生视频模型，可根据中文或英文提示生成最多 204 帧。
works.idea_en: Pushed open-model scale to 30B and documented the practical limits of scaling video diffusion.
works.idea_zh: 把开源模型规模推到 300 亿参数，并记录了视频扩散规模化的实际瓶颈。
works.method: DiT with 3D full attention, a deep-compression video VAE (16x16 spatial, 8x temporal) and Video-DPO preference tuning.
works.method_zh: 采用三维全注意力的 DiT，配深度压缩视频 VAE（空间 16×16、时间 8 倍），并用 Video-DPO 做偏好优化。

paper.title: Step-Video-T2V Technical Report: The Practice, Challenges, and Future of Video Foundation Model

works.title: Wan 2.2
works.description: Wan 2.2 (2025-07-28) is the first open mixture-of-experts video model, with cinematic controls for lighting, color and composition and a 5B model that makes 720p video on a single consumer GPU.
works.description_zh: 通义万相 Wan 2.2（2025-07-28）是首个开源的混合专家（MoE）视频模型，提供光照、色彩与构图等电影美学控制，其 50 亿参数版本可在单张消费级显卡上生成 720p 视频。
works.idea_en: Aesthetic parameters (light, lens, composition) become explicit, reproducible knobs in an open model.
works.idea_zh: 光线、镜头、构图等美学参数，在开源模型中变成明确且可复现的旋钮。
works.method: Two-expert MoE diffusion (a high-noise expert for layout, a low-noise expert for detail; 27B total, 14B active) plus a high-compression TI2V-5B model.
works.method_zh: 双专家 MoE 扩散模型（高噪声专家负责布局，低噪声专家负责细节；总参数 270 亿、激活 140 亿），另有高压缩比的 TI2V-5B 模型。

works.title: Ovi
works.description: Character.AI's Ovi (2025-09-30) is an open model that generates five seconds of 720p video together with its audio (speech, effects, music) in one pass, one of the first open-weight answers to Veo 3-style talking clips.
works.description_zh: Character.AI 的 Ovi（2025-09-30）是一个开源模型，可一次生成 5 秒 720p 视频及其音频（语音、音效、音乐），是最早回应 Veo 3 式“会说话片段”的开源权重模型之一。
works.idea_en: Open joint audio-video generation lets labs study lip-synced speech stimuli without a closed API.
works.idea_zh: 开源的音视频联合生成，让实验室无需闭源 API 就能研究口型同步的语音刺激。
works.method: Twin-backbone design: identical audio and video diffusion transformers (the video branch initialized from Wan 2.2) fused block by block with bidirectional cross-attention.
works.method_zh: 双主干设计：结构相同的音频与视频扩散 Transformer（视频分支由 Wan 2.2 初始化），逐块通过双向交叉注意力融合。

paper.title: Ovi: Twin Backbone Cross-Modal Fusion for Audio-Video Generation

works.title: LTX-2
works.description: Lightricks' LTX-2 (announced 2025-10-23, weights released afterwards) generates synchronized audio and video at up to 4K and 50 fps; LTX-2.5 followed in August 2026 as a 22B open model with a family of control LoRAs.
works.description_zh: Lightricks 的 LTX-2（2025-10-23 发布，权重随后开放）可生成同步的音频与视频，最高 4K、50 fps；LTX-2.5 于 2026 年 8 月推出，是 220 亿参数的开源模型，配有一系列控制 LoRA。
works.idea_en: Open, version-pinnable audio-video generation at production resolution, with LoRA hooks for custom control.
works.idea_zh: 可锁定版本、达到生产级分辨率的开源音视频生成，并提供用于定制控制的 LoRA 接口。
works.method: Asymmetric dual-stream transformer that generates audio and video jointly through cross-modal attention (per the LTX-2 paper).
works.method_zh: 非对称双流 Transformer，通过跨模态注意力联合生成音频与视频（据 LTX-2 论文）。
works.specs: up to 4K · up to 50 fps · up to 20 s · synchronized audio

paper.title: LTX-2: Efficient Joint Audio-Visual Foundation Model

works.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5
works.description: HunyuanVideo 1.5 (2025-11-20) is a lightweight 8.3-billion-parameter open model that produces 720p video (1080p with its super-resolution stage) and runs on consumer GPUs.
works.description_zh: HunyuanVideo 1.5（2025-11-20）是 83 亿参数的轻量开源模型，可生成 720p 视频（配合超分辨率阶段可达 1080p），能在消费级显卡上运行。
works.idea_en: The open-model race shifted to quality per parameter; a lab can run it without a cluster.
works.idea_zh: 开源模型的竞争转向“每个参数的质量”；实验室不需要集群就能运行。
works.method: DiT with selective and sliding tile attention (SSTA), glyph-aware bilingual text encoding and a video super-resolution network.
works.method_zh: 采用选择性滑动分块注意力（SSTA）的 DiT，配字形感知的中英文本编码和视频超分辨率网络。

paper.title: HunyuanVideo 1.5 Technical Report

works.title: MiniMax H3
works.description: MiniMax H3 (2026-07-31) generates up to 15 seconds of 2K video with native stereo sound from text, image, video and audio context and edits video by instruction; unusually for a flagship, MiniMax published the weights on Hugging Face.
works.description_zh: MiniMax H3（2026-07-31）可根据文本、图像、视频和音频上下文生成最长 15 秒、2K 分辨率并带原生立体声的视频，也能按指令编辑视频；少见的是，MiniMax 把这款旗舰模型的权重发布在了 Hugging Face 上。
works.idea_en: A flagship-level audio-video model with downloadable weights lets a lab pin the exact model behind its stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 可下载权重的旗舰级音视频模型，让实验室能锁定刺激材料背后的确切模型版本。
works.method: Contextual Omni Representation with an H3-VAE, an H3-Omni Transformer and in-context regeneration for editing (per MiniMax).
works.method_zh: MiniMax 称其采用上下文全模态表征（Contextual Omni Representation），包括 H3-VAE、H3-Omni Transformer，以及用于编辑的上下文再生成。
works.specs: up to 15 s · 2K · native stereo audio

works.title: Phenaki
works.description: Phenaki (Google, 2022-10-05) generated videos of variable length, up to minutes, from a sequence of prompts that change over time, for example a story told shot by shot.
works.description_zh: Phenaki（Google，2022-10-05）可根据随时间变化的一串提示生成可变长度、最长数分钟的视频，例如逐镜讲述一个故事。
works.idea_en: The first sketch of a story-driven, prompt-switching video stream, an idea later made interactive by real-time models such as LongLive.
works.idea_zh: 首次勾勒出由故事驱动、可切换提示的视频流，这一想法后来被 LongLive 等实时模型做成了交互式。
works.method: C-ViViT tokenizer that compresses video into discrete tokens, plus a bidirectional masked transformer conditioned on text that generates autoregressively in time.
works.method_zh: 用 C-ViViT 把视频压缩为离散 token，再由以文本为条件的双向掩码 Transformer 在时间维度上自回归生成。

paper.title: Phenaki: Variable Length Video Generation From Open Domain Textual Description

works.title: StreamDiffusion
works.description: StreamDiffusion (2023-12-19) restyles a live webcam or screen feed with Stable Diffusion at up to about 90 fps on one RTX 4090, and became the engine of many TouchDesigner and live-performance installations; StreamDiffusionV2 (2025-11) extends it to video diffusion models.
works.description_zh: StreamDiffusion（2023-12-19）可用 Stable Diffusion 实时重绘摄像头或屏幕画面，在单张 RTX 4090 上最高约 90 fps，成为许多 TouchDesigner 与现场表演装置的引擎；StreamDiffusionV2（2025 年 11 月）把它扩展到视频扩散模型。
works.idea_en: Per-frame diffusion on a live camera feed was the first practical way to change what a person sees as it happens.
works.idea_zh: 对实时摄像头画面逐帧扩散，是第一个能在当下改变人所见画面的实用方案。
works.method: Pipeline-level optimizations (stream batching of denoising steps, residual classifier-free guidance, a stochastic similarity filter) around few-step models such as SD-Turbo and LCM.
works.method_zh: 围绕 SD-Turbo、LCM 等少步模型的流水线级优化：去噪步的流式批处理、残差无分类器引导、随机相似度过滤。
works.specs: up to 91 fps img2img on RTX 4090 (reported)

paper.title: StreamDiffusion: A Pipeline-level Solution for Real-time Interactive Generation

works.title: CausVid
works.description: CausVid (MIT and Adobe, 2024-12) converts a slow bidirectional video diffusion model into a causal one that starts streaming frames after about 1.3 seconds at roughly 9 fps on one GPU.
works.description_zh: CausVid（MIT 与 Adobe，2024 年 12 月）把缓慢的双向视频扩散模型转换为因果模型，在单张 GPU 上约 1.3 秒后即可开始以约 9 fps 流式输出画面。
works.idea_en: Video that plays the moment you press generate: the hinge between offline clips and live, steerable streams.
works.idea_zh: 按下生成就开始播放的视频，是离线片段与可实时操控视频流之间的转折点。
works.method: Distribution-matching distillation of a bidirectional teacher into a 4-step autoregressive student with block-causal attention and KV caching.
works.method_zh: 用分布匹配蒸馏，把双向教师模型蒸馏成 4 步、块因果注意力并带 KV 缓存的自回归学生模型。

paper.title: From Slow Bidirectional to Fast Causal Video Generators

works.title: FramePack
works.description: FramePack (Lvmin Zhang and Maneesh Agrawala, Stanford, 2025-04) generates one- to two-minute image-to-video clips on a 6 GB laptop GPU by compressing past frames into a fixed-size context.
works.description_zh: FramePack（斯坦福的张吕敏与 Maneesh Agrawala，2025 年 4 月）把历史帧压缩进固定大小的上下文，从而在 6 GB 显存的笔记本 GPU 上生成 1–2 分钟的图生视频。
works.idea_en: Constant memory regardless of length makes long takes possible on ordinary hardware.
works.idea_zh: 无论视频多长，显存占用都恒定，普通硬件也能生成长镜头。
works.method: Next-frame-section prediction with progressive context packing (older frames get fewer tokens) and anti-drifting bidirectional sampling, on a HunyuanVideo backbone.
works.method_zh: 下一帧段预测，配合渐进式上下文打包（越早的帧分到越少的 token）和防漂移的双向采样，以 HunyuanVideo 为主干。

paper.title: Packing Input Frame Context in Next-Frame Prediction Models for Video Generation

works.title: MAGI-1
works.description: Sand AI's MAGI-1 (2025-04-21) is an open 24-billion-parameter autoregressive video model that generates video chunk by chunk, enabling streaming output, unlimited extension and prompt changes per chunk. Sand AI followed with MAGI-2 Preview (2026-08-05), an open 114-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 6 billion active parameters that generates 10-second clips with sound.
works.description_zh: Sand AI 的 MAGI-1（2025-04-21）是 240 亿参数的开源自回归视频模型，逐块生成视频，支持流式输出、无限延展和逐块更换提示。Sand AI 随后于 2026-08-05 发布 MAGI-2 Preview：开源的 1140 亿参数混合专家模型，每个 token 激活 60 亿参数，可生成带声音的 10 秒片段。
works.idea_en: Chunk-wise autoregression gives second-by-second control over how a scene unfolds.
works.idea_zh: 分块自回归让人能逐秒控制场景如何展开。
works.method: Autoregressive denoising over 24-frame chunks, with later chunks kept noisier while earlier ones are refined, on a transformer-based VAE.
works.method_zh: 以 24 帧为一块进行自回归去噪，越靠后的块噪声越高、前面的块逐步细化，配合基于 Transformer 的 VAE。

paper.title: MAGI-1: Autoregressive Video Generation at Scale

works.title: SkyReels-V2
works.description: Skywork's SkyReels-V2 (2025-04) is an open 'infinite-length film' model that keeps extending a video while holding shots consistent, trained with film-grammar annotations. Skywork released SkyReels V3, which adds multi-subject reference-to-video, audio-guided and video-to-video generation, as open weights on 2026-01-29.
works.description_zh: 昆仑万维 Skywork 的 SkyReels-V2（2025 年 4 月）是开源的“无限时长电影”模型，可在保持镜头一致的同时不断延展视频，训练时使用了电影语法标注。Skywork 于 2026-01-29 以开源权重发布 SkyReels V3，新增多主体参考生视频、音频引导生成与视频到视频生成。
works.idea_en: Diffusion forcing turns a clip model into a continuous storyteller, though drift still accumulates over minutes.
works.idea_zh: 扩散强制（diffusion forcing）把片段模型变成连续讲故事的模型，但时长到数分钟时漂移仍会累积。
works.method: Diffusion-forcing framework (per-token noise levels) with a multimodal captioner (SkyCaptioner) for shot language and reinforcement learning for motion quality.
works.method_zh: 采用扩散强制框架（每个 token 噪声水平不同），用多模态字幕模型 SkyCaptioner 标注镜头语言，并用强化学习提升运动质量。

paper.title: SkyReels-V2: Infinite-length Film Generative Model

works.title: Self Forcing
works.description: Self Forcing (Adobe Research and UT Austin, 2025-06) trains an autoregressive video model on its own rollouts, closing the train-test gap, and streams video at about 17 fps with sub-second latency on one H100.
works.description_zh: Self Forcing（Adobe Research 与 UT Austin，2025 年 6 月）让自回归视频模型在自身的生成结果上训练，弥合训练与推理的差距，在单张 H100 上以约 17 fps、亚秒级延迟流式生成视频。
works.idea_en: Became a common training recipe for real-time video models such as LongLive and Krea Realtime.
works.idea_zh: 成为 LongLive、Krea Realtime 等实时视频模型常用的训练方法。
works.method: Autoregressive rollout with KV caching during training, a holistic video-level distribution-matching loss and a rolling KV cache for extrapolation.
works.method_zh: 训练时就用 KV 缓存进行自回归展开，以整段视频级的分布匹配损失优化，并用滚动 KV 缓存外推更长视频。

paper.title: Self Forcing: Bridging the Train-Test Gap in Autoregressive Video Diffusion

works.title: Seaweed APT2
works.description: ByteDance Seed's Seaweed APT2 (2025-06) streams 736×416 video at 24 fps on one H100 for up to a minute, steered in real time by camera moves or, in its virtual-human demo, by a person's pose.
works.description_zh: 字节跳动 Seed 的 Seaweed APT2（2025 年 6 月）在单张 H100 上以 24 fps 流式生成 736×416 视频，最长约一分钟，可通过镜头运动实时操控，其虚拟人演示中还能由人体姿态驱动。
works.idea_en: One network evaluation per frame makes video respond to input like a game engine, at least for a minute.
works.idea_zh: 每帧只需一次网络前向，视频便能像游戏引擎一样响应输入，至少能持续一分钟。
works.method: Autoregressive adversarial post-training (AAPT): a pretrained video diffusion model is converted to emit one latent frame per network evaluation, trained adversarially with student forcing on long rollouts.
works.method_zh: 自回归对抗后训练（AAPT）：把预训练视频扩散模型改造为每次网络前向生成一个潜帧，并在长序列上以学生强制方式进行对抗训练。

paper.title: Autoregressive Adversarial Post-Training for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation

works.title: MirageLSD
works.description: Decart's MirageLSD (2025-07-17) transforms any live camera, game or video feed into a prompted style or world in real time (Decart cites under 40 ms latency at 24 fps); it was released as a web demo and mobile apps and later succeeded by Lucy 2.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 MirageLSD（2025-07-17）可按提示把任意实时摄像头、游戏或视频画面实时转换成另一种风格或世界（Decart 称延迟低于 40 毫秒、24 fps）；以网页演示和手机应用形式发布，后由 Lucy 2 接替。
works.idea_en: Live 'reskinning' of the real world is the most direct generative route to mixed-reality situations, as long as the transformation stays stable.
works.idea_zh: 对现实世界实时“换皮”，是通向混合现实情境最直接的生成路径，前提是转换保持稳定。
works.method: Live-Stream Diffusion: a causal, frame-by-frame video diffusion model that uses diffusion forcing and history augmentation to resist error accumulation, with custom GPU kernels.
works.method_zh: 实时流扩散（Live-Stream Diffusion）：逐帧因果视频扩散模型，借助扩散强制与历史增强抵抗误差累积，并使用定制 GPU 内核。
keywords: official clip from archived launch page

works.title: LongLive
works.description: LongLive (NVIDIA, MIT, HKUST (Guangzhou) and others, 2025-09) generates video in real time for up to four minutes while the user types new prompts mid-stream, with smooth transitions between them.
works.description_zh: LongLive（NVIDIA、MIT、港科大（广州）等，2025 年 9 月）可实时生成最长 4 分钟的视频，用户能在生成过程中随时输入新提示，画面会平滑过渡。
works.idea_en: A running scene that changes when told to is the core of a directable situation.
works.idea_zh: 一个正在进行、听指令就能改变的场景，是可导演情境的核心。
works.method: Frame-level autoregressive model with KV re-caching on prompt switches, streaming long tuning and short-window attention with a frame sink.
works.method_zh: 帧级自回归模型，切换提示时重建 KV 缓存，采用流式长视频微调和带帧汇聚（frame sink）的短窗口注意力。

paper.title: LongLive: Real-time Interactive Long Video Generation

works.title: Krea Realtime 14B
works.description: Krea Realtime 14B (2025-10-15) is an open text-to-video model distilled from Wan 2.1 14B that streams at about 11 fps on one B200 and lets users change prompts or restyle video while it is generating.
works.description_zh: Krea Realtime 14B（2025-10-15）是从 Wan 2.1 14B 蒸馏而来的开源文生视频模型，在单张 B200 上约 11 fps 流式生成，用户可在生成过程中更换提示或重绘画面风格。
works.idea_en: Real-time generation at 14B scale shows interactivity no longer requires a small, low-quality model.
works.idea_zh: 140 亿参数规模的实时生成表明，交互性不再必须以小而粗糙的模型为代价。
works.method: Self Forcing distillation of a bidirectional 14B model into an autoregressive one, with KV-cache recomputation and attention-bias techniques against error accumulation.
works.method_zh: 用 Self Forcing 把 140 亿参数的双向模型蒸馏为自回归模型，并用 KV 缓存重算与注意力偏置抑制误差累积。
works.specs: 14B · ~11 fps on 1 B200 · ~1 s to first frame

works.title: Lucy 2
works.description: Decart's Lucy 2 (2026-01-26) edits a live video stream at 1080p and 30 fps with near-zero latency, from character swaps and clothing changes to product placement and full environment changes driven by text and reference images; Lucy 2.5 (2026-07-16) improved temporal stability.
works.description_zh: Decart 的 Lucy 2（2026-01-26）能以 1080p、30 fps、近乎零延迟编辑实时视频流，依据文本和参考图完成角色替换、换装、植入商品乃至整体环境变换；Lucy 2.5（2026-07-16）提升了时间稳定性。
works.idea_en: Live, reference-guided transformation of a person's camera view is the building block for generative mixed-reality conditions.
works.idea_zh: 基于参考图对人的实时画面进行变换，是构建生成式混合现实实验条件的基本模块。
works.method: Real-time world-transformation video model building on MirageLSD and Lucy Edit; Decart reports it learns physical consistency without depth maps or 3D.
works.method_zh: 在 MirageLSD 与 Lucy Edit 基础上构建的实时“世界变换”视频模型；Decart 称其无需深度图或三维信息即可学到物理一致性。

works.title: Helios
works.description: Helios (Peking University with ByteDance, 2026-03) is an open 14-billion-parameter model that generates minute-scale video in real time on a single H100, showing large real-time models can match small ones in speed.
works.description_zh: Helios（北京大学与字节跳动，2026 年 3 月）是 140 亿参数的开源模型，可在单张 H100 上实时生成分钟级视频，表明大规模实时模型在速度上也能追平小模型。
works.idea_en: Real-time no longer means 1.3B: quality and responsiveness stop being a trade-off.
works.idea_zh: 实时不再意味着只能用 13 亿参数的小模型：质量与响应速度不必二选一。
works.method: Autoregressive video diffusion with techniques for long-horizon stability and efficient inference (per the Helios paper).
works.method_zh: 自回归视频扩散，结合长时稳定性与高效推理技术（据 Helios 论文）。

paper.title: Helios: Real Real-Time Long Video Generation Model

works.title: Vidu S1
works.description: Vidu S1 (2026-07-03) is Shengshu's real-time interactive video model: a generated character or scene responds within milliseconds as you talk to it, for uses such as talking pets or gaming companions.
works.description_zh: Vidu S1（2026-07-03）是生数科技的实时交互视频模型：你对它说话时，生成的角色或场景会在毫秒级作出回应，可用于“会说话的宠物”、游戏陪伴等场景。
works.idea_en: Conversation-paced video generation moves video models into the turn-taking loop of virtual humans.
works.idea_zh: 跟得上对话节奏的视频生成，把视频模型带进了虚拟人的轮流对话循环。
works.method: Real-time video generation conditioned on streaming voice input; architecture not published.
works.method_zh: 以流式语音输入为条件的实时视频生成；架构未公开。

works.title: 360DVD
works.description: 360DVD (Peking University, CVPR 2024) generates 360° equirectangular panorama videos from text, with optional motion conditions, for viewing in a VR headset.
works.description_zh: 360DVD（北京大学，CVPR 2024）可从文字生成 360° 等距柱状全景视频，并可加入运动条件，供 VR 头显观看。
works.idea_en: One of the first ways to generate surround video a person can look around in, rather than a framed view.
works.idea_zh: 最早能生成可环顾四周的环绕视频（而不是一个画框）的方法之一。
works.method: Lightweight 360-Adapter with 360°-specific enhancements on a pretrained text-to-video model, trained on the WEB360 panorama-video dataset.
works.method_zh: 在预训练文生视频模型上加入轻量的 360-Adapter 及针对 360° 的增强技术，使用 WEB360 全景视频数据集训练。

paper.title: 360DVD: Controllable Panorama Video Generation with 360-Degree Video Diffusion Model

works.title: StereoCrafter
works.description: StereoCrafter (Tencent ARC Lab, 2024-09) converts ordinary 2D videos into long, high-fidelity stereoscopic 3D for headsets such as Apple Vision Pro, using a video diffusion model to fill disoccluded regions.
works.description_zh: StereoCrafter（腾讯 ARC 实验室，2024 年 9 月）可把普通 2D 视频转换为长时、高保真的立体 3D 视频，供 Apple Vision Pro 等头显观看，并用视频扩散模型补全视差暴露出的遮挡区域。
works.idea_en: Any existing or generated clip can become stereo, the cheapest path from flat stimuli to headset stimuli.
works.idea_zh: 任何现有或生成的片段都能转成立体视频，是从平面刺激走向头显刺激成本最低的路径。
works.method: Depth-based forward warping to a second view, then a stereo video inpainting diffusion model trained on large stereo video data fills the holes.
works.method_zh: 先基于深度做前向变换得到第二视角，再用在大规模立体视频上训练的扩散修补模型填补空洞。

paper.title: StereoCrafter: Diffusion-based Generation of Long and High-fidelity Stereoscopic 3D from Monocular Videos

works.title: Imagine360
works.description: Imagine360 (CUHK and Shanghai AI Laboratory, NeurIPS 2025) expands an ordinary perspective video into a full 360° video, inventing the surroundings outside the original frame while keeping its motion.
works.description_zh: Imagine360（香港中文大学与上海人工智能实验室，NeurIPS 2025）可把普通透视视频扩展成完整的 360° 视频，在保留原有运动的同时补全画框之外的周边环境。
works.idea_en: Turns phone footage of an event into surround material a participant can look around in.
works.idea_zh: 把手机拍下的事件画面变成参与者可以环顾的环绕素材。
works.method: Dual-branch perspective/panorama diffusion with antipodal masking and elevation-aware design, trained on panoramic video.
works.method_zh: 透视/全景双分支扩散，配合对跖遮罩（antipodal mask）与仰角感知设计，在全景视频上训练。

paper.title: Imagine360: Immersive 360 Video Generation from Perspective Anchor

works.title: StereoPilot
works.description: StereoPilot (HKUST (Guangzhou) with Kuaishou's Kling team, 2025-12) converts monocular video to stereo for both parallel and converged camera setups in a single efficient pass, using generative video priors.
works.description_zh: StereoPilot（港科大（广州）与快手可灵团队，2025 年 12 月）借助生成式视频先验，一次高效推理即可把单目视频转换为平行式或会聚式两种立体格式。
works.idea_en: Fast, format-aware stereo conversion lets a lab deliver generated scenes to different headsets without re-rendering.
works.idea_zh: 快速且区分立体格式的转换，让实验室无需重新渲染就能把生成场景投放到不同头显上。
works.method: Unified feed-forward stereo conversion on a video-generation backbone, trained on a curated dataset covering parallel and converged stereo.
works.method_zh: 基于视频生成主干的统一前馈式立体转换，在涵盖平行与会聚两种立体格式的数据集上训练。

paper.title: StereoPilot: Learning Unified and Efficient Stereo Conversion via Generative Priors

works.title: 360Anything
works.description: 360Anything (Google DeepMind with the University of Toronto, ECCV 2026) lifts any perspective image or video, including footage from the Genie 3 world model, to a seamless 360° panorama without camera calibration.
works.description_zh: 360Anything（Google DeepMind 与多伦多大学，ECCV 2026）无需相机标定，就能把任意透视图像或视频（包括 Genie 3 世界模型的画面）提升为无缝的 360° 全景。
works.idea_en: Any generated clip, even a world-model rollout, can be wrapped around the viewer after the fact.
works.idea_zh: 任何生成片段，哪怕是世界模型的推演画面，都可以事后“包裹”到观看者四周。
works.method: Geometry-free diffusion transformer that learns from data where the perspective input sits inside the panorama, without explicit camera intrinsics or extrinsics.
works.method_zh: 无需几何先验的扩散 Transformer，从数据中学习透视输入在全景中的位置，不依赖显式的相机内外参。

paper.title: 360Anything: Geometry-Free Lifting of Images and Videos to 360°
